column1: # ACTION p376-D — "find the channel that reads a Maven PARENT POM grant from outside the
# repository, or establish that there is none here and record the class."
# 🟢 THE CHANNEL EXISTS, and a parent-POM <licenses> block IS readable from this environment.
# 🔴 AND THIS PASS'S FIRST WRITE-UP OF THE SECOND HALF WAS WRONG.  Both are recorded.
## 🔴 THE ERROR, FIRST, BECAUSE IT IS THE MORE USEFUL HALF.
# This pass's first draft graded fr/openent/ ABSENT on a 404, reasoning that "a 404 from a host
# that answered 200 on a control in the same minute is a measured absence".  It then found
# `compose/code/p233-maven-channel` ALREADY ON THESE SHELVES, whose headline is exactly
# "a 404 is not an ABSENCE": on a rate-limited channel PRESENCE is provable and ABSENCE is not,
# unless a known positive passed IN THE SAME WINDOW.  🔴 In the first probe sequence the control
# returned 429 and only passed on a LATER retry — so there was NO passing control in the target's
# window, and p233's own classifier grades that first measurement NOT-ESTABLISHED, not ABSENT.
# 🔵 The claim was re-earned by re-probing, not by argument.  An instrument this base already
# owned caught an overstatement its author had already written down.
## 🟢 THE RE-PROBE, run to p233's rule: control and target in ONE window, each probe to its OWN file.

column1: ## 🟢 A REFINEMENT OF p233, measured rather than assumed — the channel's behaviour has CHANGED.
# p233 recorded that repo1.maven.org answered "404 with a one-byte body" while throttling, which
# made the throttle BYTE-IDENTICAL to a real miss.  🟢 THAT IS NO LONGER TRUE FROM HERE:
#   throttle  = HTTP 429, 96 B, body "Your ip has exceeded rate limits. Find out more here ..."
#   real miss = HTTP 404, 554 B, nginx's standard error page
# 🟢 They are distinguishable by STATUS and by SHAPE.  p233's CAUTION still governs — a control
# must still pass in-window — but the two responses are no longer indistinguishable, which makes
# ABSENT cheaper to earn on this channel than p233 had to assume.
